name: Kash Patel
summary: Kash Patel has led the FBI since the Senate confirmed him 51–47 in February 2025. A former federal prosecutor and House Intelligence Committee aide who wrote the 2018 Nunes memo, he held national-security posts late in Trump’s first term. In September 2026 Senate Democrats pressed him at an oversight hearing over bureau hiring policy and his lawsuit against a magazine that reported on his drinking, which he denies.
